cards.ex: I can whip up a quick pasta dish if you're hungry.
cards.exUz: Agar qorning och bo'lsa, tezda makaronli taom tayyorlab beraman.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oson biror narsani tayyorlamoq, odatda ovqat.

cards.ex: She's a real foodie; she always knows the best restaurants.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy taom shinavandasi; u har doim eng yaxshi restoranlarni biladi.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatni sevuvchi, yangi taomlarni sinashni yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: Rice is a staple food in many Asian countries.
cards.exUz: Guruch ko'plab Osiyo mamlakatlarida asosiy oziq-ovqat hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik iste'mol qilinadigan, muhim oziq-ovqat mahsuloti.

cards.ex: I had a gut feeling that the fish wasn't fresh.
cards.exUz: Menda baliq yangi emasligi haqida ichki sezgi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir to'g'ri yoki noto'g'ri ekanligini his qilish, ayniqsa ovqat haqida.

cards.ex: Portion control is key to maintaining a healthy weight.
cards.exUz: Sog'lom vaznni saqlash uchun porsiya nazorati muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqat miqdorini nazorat qilish, keragidan ortiq yemash.

cards.ex: He hadn't had a square meal in days.
cards.exUz: U bir necha kundan beri to'yimli ovqat yemagan edi.
cards.uzDef: To'liq, to'yimli ovqat, odatda tushlik yoki kechki ovqat.

cards.ex: Reducing food miles helps the environment.
cards.exUz: Oziq-ovqat masofasini kamaytirish atrof-muhitga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqatning yetishtirilgan joyidan iste'mol qilinadigan joygacha bosib o'tgan masofasi.

cards.ex: Don't eat it if it's past the sell-by date.
cards.exUz: Agar sotish muddati o'tgan bo'lsa, uni yemang.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulotni sotish uchun tavsiya etilgan sana.

cards.ex: We need to stock up on canned goods before the hurricane.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron oldidan konservalangan mahsulotlarni zaxira qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p miqdorda biror narsani, masalan oziq-ovqatni zaxira qilmoq.

cards.ex: I'm trying to cut out sugar from my diet.
cards.exUz: Men ratsionimdan shakarni chiqarib tashlashga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Ratsiondan biror narsani butunlay olib tashlamoq.

cards.ex: Let's eat out tonight; I don't feel like cooking.
cards.exUz: Keling, bugun kechqurun tashqarida ovqatlanaylik; ovqat qilishni xohlamayman.
cards.uzDef: Uyda emas, balki restoranda yoki kafeda ovqatlanmoq.

cards.ex: Combining those two ingredients is a recipe for disaster.
cards.exUz: Bu ikki ingredientni birlashtirish - falokat retsepti.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri harakatlar yoki omillar kombinatsiyasi, muvaffaqiyatsizlikka olib kelishi aniq.

cards.ex: I'm having a craving for chocolate cake.
cards.exUz: Mening shokoladli tortga ishtaham tortyapti.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani juda xohlash, ayniqsa ovqatni.

cards.ex: The milk went bad because I left it out.
cards.exUz: Sut tashqarida qolgani uchun buzilib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqatning sifati yomonlashishi, yeyishga yaroqsiz bo'lib qolishi.

cards.ex: Chicken breast is a good source of lean protein.
cards.exUz: Tovuq ko'kragi - kam yog'li proteinning yaxshi manbai.
cards.uzDef: Kam yog'li, sog'lom protein manbai.

cards.ex: A balanced meal should include protein, carbs, and vegetables.
cards.exUz: Muvozanatli ovqat tarkibida protein, uglevodlar va sabzavotlar bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Har xil oziq moddalari bo'lgan ovqat.

cards.ex: Food security is a major concern in developing countries.
cards.exUz: Oziq-ovqat xavfsizligi rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlarda asosiy muammo hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqatga doimiy kirish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: I love buying farm-fresh produce at the market.
cards.exUz: Bozordan fermerdan yangi mahsulotlar sotib olishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Fermadan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kelgan, yangi oziq-ovqat.

cards.ex: He was drinking some kind of rotgut whiskey.
cards.exUz: U bir turdagi sifatsiz viski ichayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Sifatsiz, arzon alkogol ichimligi.

cards.ex: We're doing a taste test to see which coffee is best.
cards.exUz: Qaysi kofe eng yaxshi ekanligini aniqlash uchun ta'm sinovini o'tkazamiz.
cards.uzDef: Ovqat yoki ichimlikning ta'mini sinab ko'rish.

cards.ex: I know he's grumpy, but a hungry man is an angry man.
cards.exUz: Men bilaman, u jahldor, lekin och odam - jahldor odam.
cards.term: a hungry man is an angry man
cards.uzDef: Ochlik g'azabni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

cards.ex: He's such a spoiled brat; he always gets what he wants.
cards.exUz: U shunday erka bolaki; u har doim xohlaganini oladi.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari erkalangan, injiq bola.

cards.ex: Let's go for a hike to work up an appetite for dinner.
cards.exUz: Kechki ovqatga ishtaha ochish uchun piyoda yurishga boraylik.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy mashqlar orqali ishtaha ochmoq.

cards.ex: He had to eat humble pie after his prediction was wrong.
cards.exUz: U bashorati noto'g'ri chiqqanidan keyin kechirim so'rashga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatosini tan olish va kechirim so'rash.

cards.ex: He tried to butter his boss up before asking for a raise.
cards.exUz: U ish haqini oshirishni so'rashdan oldin boshlig'ini maqtashga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Maqtovlar bilan biror kimsaning ko'nglini olmoq.

cards.ex: You can't have your cake and eat it too; you have to choose.
cards.exUz: Siz bir vaqtning o'zida ham qovun, ham tarvuzni xohlashingiz mumkin emas; siz tanlashingiz kerak.
cards.term: have your cake and eat it too
cards.uzDef: Bir vaqtning o'zida ikki zid narsani xohlash.

cards.ex: In a nutshell, the food was delicious.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, ovqat mazali edi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqacha, aniq qilib aytganda.

cards.ex: Teaching is my bread and butter.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchilik - mening tirikchilik manbaʼim.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy daromad manbai, kundalik tirikchilik vositasi.

cards.ex: Let's spice things up by adding some hot sauce.
cards.exUz: Keling, achchiq sous qo'shib, uni qiziqroq qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qiziqarliroq, hayajonliroq qilish.

cards.ex: Mac and cheese is my ultimate soul food.
cards.exUz: Makaron va pishloq - mening eng yaxshi ko'ngil ovqatim.
cards.uzDef: Ruhiy taskin beruvchi, an'anaviy taomlar.
